annotation.title_clean: Act on Promotion of Research and Development, and Utilization of Artificial Intelligence-related Technology Now in Full Effect
annotation.title_en: Act on Promotion of Research and Development, and Utilization of Artificial Intelligence-related Technology Now in Full Effect
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government of Japan (Highlighting Japan, Government Public Relations Office)
annotation.summary_en: Government magazine article overviewing Japan's AI Promotion Act, fully in effect since September 2025. It describes a light-touch, innovation-oriented approach relying on existing laws and ministry guidelines, plus an AI Strategic Headquarters, an AI Basic Plan, and ties to the Hiroshima AI Process. No robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Act creates an AI Strategic Headquarters chaired by the Prime Minister with all Cabinet ministers
Government must formulate an AI Basic Plan, to be finalized within 2025
Risk mitigation relies on existing laws and ministerial guidelines, avoiding excessive regulation
Guidelines to ensure transparency, fairness and safety in line with international norms
Applies to foreign businesses targeting Japanese businesses or citizens; draws on Hiroshima AI Process
